name: yc application reader
description: how a yc application reader sees a project: what the team built, who uses it, how fast, and whether the market is big.

criteria.name: a specific user with a real pain
criteria.description: the project names who has the problem and why it hurts
criteria.strong_answer: a named user or segment and evidence they have this problem today

criteria.name: built and demonstrable
criteria.description: something real exists, not a plan
criteria.strong_answer: working code a reader can run or see

criteria.name: momentum per unit of time
criteria.description: impressive progress for the age of the project

criteria.name: a market worth serving
criteria.description: the market is big or a wedge into a big market
criteria.strong_answer: a stated market with any credible size argument

criteria.name: users or a way to get them
criteria.description: any real usage, or a credible first-users plan
criteria.strong_answer: user counts, waitlists, or a specific first channel

required_questions: what do they do with it today
red_flags: a product with no user named
a market size with no source
objection_seeds: why does this need to exist now
what stops an incumbent from doing this
trusted_evidence: repo evidence of a working build
stated user numbers with a source
